data: what is the approximate range of annotator accuracy after 300 examples have been annotated?

The figure shows the accuracy range of annotators on the NLI training and hidden unanimous examples as they annotated their first 300 examples. The x-axis represents the number of examples, and the y-axis represents accuracy. The blue line represents the average accuracy, while the shaded area represents the range of annotator accuracy. After 300 examples have been annotated, the approximate range of annotator accuracy is between approximately 0.875 and 0.925.
